			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary }

							limit = { var:tv_wonder_function_units < 6 }

					}

				if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 5 } }
					prev = {
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked value = 1 }
